16_selection_rationale: An unusually wide stop relative to the prevailing M5 ATR(14) at decision time plausibly indicates either a lower-quality/less-precise structural pullback (the protected swing sits unusually far from the retracement entry) or an entry taken further into an already-extended move than the typical setup. This is consistent with the observed pattern in the consumed data: the widest-stop quintile (stop_distance_atr in (3.975, 10.460]) is the only one of five quintiles across all three tested variables whose grouped 95% confidence interval excludes zero (mean -0.327R, CI [-0.480, -0.146], 0% positive folds across all 8 folds), while the tightest-stop quintile is the single best-performing bucket (+0.175R).
